description: W2d G-R1 lesson library: past mistakes of the HLMemo project, paraphrased from the public docs/decisions (D-0xx) and docs/consults, registered via memory.register_lesson (lessons) or memory.write (experiences, distractor facts). project: main = the caller's home project, shell = another granted project, global = hlm-global (granted, reserved, policy librarian=off), secret = a project the caller has NO grant on, main-work = home project with device_scope class:work (the caller is personal). scope 'self' = device:<caller id>.

lessons.mistake: deploy.sh piped the remote script into `ssh host bash -s`; `docker compose exec -T db pg_dump` and `docker compose run --rm migrate` inside it read stdin and swallowed the rest of the script, so the first deploy exited 0 with the app never started.
lessons.fix: Never let a command inside a script piped to `bash -s` read stdin: give it `</dev/null` (or copy the script to the host and run the file).
lessons.context:
Reproduced with `printf 'echo a
cat>/dev/null
echo b
' | bash -s` printing only `a`.

lessons.mistake: An `ssh` inside a `while read ...; do ...; done < hosts.txt` loop (and inside a heredoc script) read the loop's stdin, so the loop stopped after the first host.
lessons.fix: Use `ssh -n` (or `< /dev/null`) for every ssh call inside a read loop or heredoc.
lessons.context: Same stdin-swallowing class as the bash -s deploy bug.

lessons.mistake: pytest was run without HLM_TEST_DSN; the conftest fell back to the compose `hlm` dev database and its autouse fixture truncated every table, wiping the corpus-A import.
lessons.fix: Always export HLM_TEST_DSN pointing at a disposable database (hlm_test_<ws>) before any pytest run; the conftest now refuses the protected `hlm` database.
lessons.context: Incident 2026-09-23 10:02 UTC during the D-055 verification round.

lessons.mistake: The deploy runner uses `umask 077`, so the checkout was 0600 and the worker container (uid 10001) could not read its bind-mounted entrypoint: crash loop on the first real deploy.
lessons.fix: After every checkout (and every rollback checkout) make each bind-mounted file group/other-readable; add any new bind-mounted file to that list.
lessons.context: Found in the lima rehearsal; local gates could not see it.

lessons.mistake: In a zsh script `FLAGS="--frozen --extra dev"; uv sync $FLAGS` passed ONE argument with spaces, because zsh does not word-split unquoted parameter expansions.
lessons.fix: Use an array (`flags=(--frozen --extra dev); cmd "${flags[@]}"`) or `${=FLAGS}` in zsh.
lessons.context: bash splits the same line; the bug only appears under zsh (macOS default shell).

lessons.mistake: In zsh `grep -rn foo src --include=*.py` failed with `no matches found: --include=*.py` and grep never ran, because an unquoted glob that matches nothing is an error in zsh.
lessons.fix: Quote glob patterns meant for the program: `--include='*.py'`.
lessons.context: Happens in zsh one-liners run by agents on macOS.

lessons.mistake: The pre-commit gitleaks hook flagged a test fixture full of fake high-entropy tokens and the commit was forced through with `git commit --no-verify`.
lessons.fix: Add a narrow allowlist entry for that one fixture path in the gitleaks config and commit normally; never bypass the hook and never disable the scanner.
lessons.context: The repository is public (D-011); the hook is the secret gate.

lessons.mistake: A threshold was about to be chosen by scoring the sealed corpus-B split, which would have turned the hold-out into a tuning set.
lessons.fix: Tune only on the dev split and corpus A; the sealed split is scored once, in aggregate, for the final confirmation.

lessons.mistake: An implementer applied a new migration to the shared dev database `hlm`; the running dev API answered /ready 503 for hours.
lessons.fix: Implementer agents migrate and test only on their own hlm_test_<ws> database; hlm, hlm_verify and hlm_retr are off-limits (read-only dump at most).

lessons.mistake: `docker compose down -v` was used to restart a stack and also deleted the named pgdata volume with an expensive import in it.
lessons.fix: Use `docker compose down` (without -v) on any stack whose database matters; -v only for truly disposable stacks.
lessons.context: -v removes named volumes declared in the compose file.

lessons.mistake: `ssh host 'pkill -f hlmemo.worker'` killed the ssh session itself, because the remote shell's own command line contains the pattern.
lessons.fix: Stop processes by pidfile, `systemctl`/`docker` or `pgrep -f` with an anchored pattern that cannot match the ssh command line.
lessons.context: Seen while stopping a stuck import on the VPS.

lessons.mistake: psycopg started preparing the candidate queries server-side after 5 executions; Postgres switched to a generic plan that dropped the GIN index and p50 went from 250 ms to 2 s.
lessons.fix: Execute hot candidate-retrieval queries with `prepare=False` so every execution gets a custom plan.

lessons.mistake: pg_trgm word_similarity_threshold at 0.1 made the GIN recheck scan every chunk: 3-7 s per identifier term, with no recall gain.
lessons.fix: Keep word_similarity_threshold at 0.9 (recall is identical at 0.7-0.9).

lessons.mistake: A CI step ran `pytest -q | tee pytest.log`; pytest failed but the step passed, because `$?` of a pipeline is the status of `tee`.
lessons.fix: Use `set -o pipefail` (or write to a file and check the command's own exit status).
lessons.context: Applies to any `cmd | tee` or `cmd | tail` whose status matters.

lessons.mistake: The request middleware buffered every response until commit; the endless MCP SSE stream was buffered too, so headers and pings never flushed and clients hung.
lessons.fix: Buffer only finite responses; for text/event-stream commit first, then pass the stream through unbuffered.

lessons.mistake: A long deploy was run from this laptop over a foreground ssh session; the Mac slept, ssh dropped (SIGPIPE mid-migration) and nothing recovered.
lessons.fix: Run long remote deploys detached on the host (nohup/systemd-run) with a status file and poll it; never let the laptop keep the deploy alive.
lessons.context: Device-specific: this MacBook sleeps on lid close.

lessons.mistake: Right after the first production deploy the public https /ready check timed out and was treated as a failure, but ACME certificate issuance simply had not finished yet (false negative).
lessons.fix: On a first deploy wait for certificate issuance (or check the local endpoint on the host) before declaring failure or rolling back.

lessons.mistake: A CLI could not reach the remote memory server because a stale local-scope `hlm` MCP entry (127.0.0.1:8765) shadowed the correct user-scope registration.
lessons.fix: When a CLI cannot reach the server, list and remove the entries of every scope (local, project, user) before re-adding one.

lessons.mistake: compose published Postgres on all interfaces (0.0.0.0:5432) with the default hlm/hlm credentials.
lessons.fix: Bind Postgres to 127.0.0.1 locally and never publish it in production; reach it through an SSH tunnel.
lessons.context: Security finding S4 of the Phase-0 review.

lessons.mistake: Processes that loaded the local ONNX embedder aborted at interpreter shutdown (native abort, exit code 134) because of ONNX Runtime's telemetry thread.
lessons.fix: Set ORT_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 in every process that loads the embedder (API, worker, CLIs, test runs) before onnxruntime is imported.

lessons.mistake: Changing how the idempotency request hash is computed broke retries of events written before the upgrade: the retry no longer matched and got E_REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT.
lessons.fix: Version the hash algorithm, store the version on the event and use the recorded version when a retry is compared.

lessons.mistake: On the work machine an account-wide provider operation was about to touch every VPS of the hosting account.
lessons.fix: Name the single target VM explicitly in every firewall/snapshot/restart call.

lessons.mistake: A 38 MB write was embedded by loading every chunk at once; the worker was OOM-killed.
lessons.fix: Process large writes with keyset-paged chunk reads and token-capped embedding batches.

lessons.mistake: `alembic upgrade head` failed as ambiguous: the migration history has a second branch head (hnsw).
lessons.fix: Always upgrade to the labelled head: `alembic upgrade main@head`.
lessons.context: compose migrate service, deploy scripts, tests.

lessons.mistake: The deploy stopped the writers before taking the backup; when the S3 upload failed the production stack stayed down.
lessons.fix: Take and verify the backup BEFORE stopping api/worker; stop writers only after the backup succeeded.

lessons.mistake: Backup retention deleted same-day pre-upgrade dumps that the rollback path depended on.
lessons.fix: Retention must never prune pre-upgrade dumps, even when newer dumps exist for the same day.

lessons.mistake: Some models wrap JSON in ``` fences or add a prose preamble even in JSON mode; parsing the raw content crashed librarian jobs.
lessons.fix: Strip fences, parse, validate against the task schema, retry once and count failures instead of crashing.
lessons.context: Cross-project experience from the librarian bench.

lessons.mistake: A 'reasoning off' request parameter was silently ignored by the provider, so a model benchmark underestimated latency and cost.
lessons.fix: Read reasoning_tokens from the usage block of every response instead of trusting the request parameter.

lessons.mistake: `git add -A` in a tree that holds hlm.toml, .env and device tokens nearly pushed private deployment config into the public repository.
lessons.fix: Stage explicit paths; keep only the example files (hlm.example.toml) tracked; private config lives in the private ops repo.

lessons.mistake: Switching the embedding model was planned as a DDL change of embeddings.vec to a new vector(N) type.
lessons.fix: A model switch is a re-embed job: vectors are untyped with dims and model@revision per row, and the ANN index is a per-model partial index.

lessons.mistake: While parallel agents were editing the same checkout, the orchestrator ran `git add -A` and swept an agent's half-written test into its commit.
lessons.fix: With parallel agents, stage explicit paths only (or give each agent its own worktree) and re-run the tests before committing.

lessons.mistake: A crash test sent `kill -9 1` inside the container; the signal was silently dropped (PID 1 of a PID namespace ignores it) and the test proved nothing.
lessons.fix: Force an unignorable fault (exit from the process under test, or kill it from outside the container) to simulate a crash.

lessons.mistake: The psycopg_pool configure callback ran SET statements and returned the connection in a transaction (INTRANS); the pool discarded every such connection.
lessons.fix: End the configure callback with `await conn.commit()` so the pool receives an idle connection.

lessons.mistake: Chunk GIN indexes with the default fastupdate pending list made queries during a burst of writes take 6.5 s (p95 6.7 s instead of 269 ms).
lessons.fix: Create chunk GIN indexes with fastupdate=off and flush existing pending lists (gin_clean_pending_list).

lessons.mistake: A librarian design held a database transaction (with row locks) open across the LLM call.
lessons.fix: Read in a short committed transaction, call the LLM with no transaction open, then apply in a new transaction that re-checks authority.

lessons.mistake: The cheapest librarian candidate (gemini-3.1-flash-lite) complied with prompt injections in stored memory 21 of 30 times.
lessons.fix: Run the injection family of the bench before adopting any librarian model or fallback; exclude models that comply.

lessons.mistake: A project card written with a device-scoped device_scope locked every other device out of card updates.
lessons.fix: Project cards are always device_scope=all.

lessons.mistake: /ready borrowed a connection from the request pool and answered 503 under pool pressure.
lessons.fix: Readiness uses its own bounded DB connection, independent of the traffic pools.

lessons.mistake: The worker logged its DSN including the database password.
lessons.fix: Never log DSNs or URLs with credentials; log host/db only or redact the password.
lessons.context: Found in the Phase-0 final audit.

lessons.mistake: A synchronous HTTP call to a cloud embedding API inside embed_query pushed query p95 to 1.1 s.
lessons.fix: Network embeddings must run asynchronously, concurrently with the SQL legs, with a cache and a hard timeout.

lessons.mistake: A manual rollback of production to a pre-W0 release could silently reopen public device registration.
lessons.fix: Never roll back across a one-way-door release; roll forward with the current code plus a restored dump.

lessons.mistake: A failed deploy left the hlmemo:prod image tag pointing at the failed release, so a later restore/up ran the failed code.
lessons.fix: Retag the production image only after the release is accepted; on failure restore the previous tag.

lessons.mistake: restore.sh started the app with `up --no-deps`, skipping the migrate service, so current code ran on an older schema.
lessons.fix: A restore must run the migrations (alembic upgrade main@head) before starting api/worker.

lessons.mistake: The body budget reserved the declared Content-Length in full before any byte arrived, so a few fake large uploads exhausted it.
lessons.fix: Charge only bytes actually received and apply the minimum-rate check from the first byte.

lessons.mistake: Every write invalidated the DF term-statistics cache and the next query blocked on a ~210 ms rebuild.
lessons.fix: Serve the cached DF stale-while-revalidate with a single-flight background refresh (bounded staleness).

lessons.mistake: Flushing the GIN pending lists inside the migration transaction that altered the indexes took a long table lock on the live database.
lessons.fix: Run gin_clean_pending_list in an autocommit step outside the migration transaction (or leave it to autovacuum).

lessons.mistake: A correctness fix to the candidate SQL silently lost the GIN index; query p95 jumped to 5.3 s and only the latency gate noticed.
lessons.fix: Re-run the G4 latency gate (and EXPLAIN) after every change to candidate-retrieval SQL.

lessons.mistake: Under contention lock_timeout turned an expected E_VERSION_CONFLICT into a retryable E_UNAVAILABLE.
lessons.fix: Let write advisory-lock waits use the request's DB budget and map conflicts after authorization.

lessons.mistake: Validation errors echoed the whole input back, producing a 3 MB error envelope.
lessons.fix: Validation error details never include the input; clip messages and cap the number of errors.

lessons.mistake: Wiping the dev stack with docker compose down -v destroyed a corpus import (secret project copy).
lessons.fix: Never use down -v on stacks with valuable data.
lessons.context: Stored in a project the caller has no grant on: must never be returned.

facts.title: Deploy pipeline overview
facts.body: deploy.sh copies the release to the host, pipes remote-deploy.sh into ssh bash -s, runs docker compose run --rm migrate and docker compose up -d api worker, then checks /ready.

facts.title: Test databases
facts.body: Each workstream has its own database hlm_test_<ws>; HLM_TEST_DSN selects it for pytest. The dev stack database is hlm.

facts.title: Backup timer
facts.body: backup.sh dumps Postgres with pg_dump -Fc and uploads the dump to S3-compatible storage; the systemd timer is intentionally not installed yet.

facts.title: Trigram settings
facts.body: The trigram candidate list uses pg_trgm word_similarity with SET LOCAL pg_trgm.word_similarity_threshold per query.
